items.source: The default implementation always returns true. This can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现始终返回true。 这可以在子类中重写。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when something unintended appears to have
happened with an update, but the transaction hasn't already been rolled back.
Thrown, for example, when we wanted to update 1 row in an RDBMS but actually
updated 3.
items.translation: 当更新操作发生意外情况但事务尚未回滚时，会抛出数据访问异常。例如，当我们希望在一个关系型数据库（RDBMS）中更新 1 行记录，但实际上更新了 3 行时，就会抛出此类异常。

items.source: cause - the root cause from the underlying API, such as JDBC
items.translation: cause - 来自底层 API（如 JDBC）的根本原因。
